posting.title: Ketel One District Manager - Boston, MA
posting.description:
Job Details

The Ketel One District Manager is responsible for supporting the achievement of Ketel One activation, distribution and performance in the Boston market. Inherent in this responsibility is developing and maintaining distributor and DIAGEO relationships as well as major customer relationships. The Ketel One District Manager will call on and activate key On-Premise accounts and be held accountable to key performance indicators (KPI’s) with a focus on education, menu execution and program quality management to help drive Rate-of-Sale, while working closely and collaboratively with distributor and DIAGEO teams to achieve overall market objectives.


Job Responsibilities

•   Support Ketel One activity at On-Premise account level within budget and legal/regulatory compliance: approximately 80% time spent in field and 20% spent in office conducting administrative and planning duties

•   Multiply through distributor and DIAGEO by supporting focused implementation of Ketel One programming in market

•   Participate in monthly and quarterly business reviews with distributor and DIAGEO teams

•   Conduct educational seminars and tastings at the account level to educate retailers, gatekeepers and consumers

•   Constantly train and develop distributor personnel on the Ketel One brand philosophy and execution standards

•   Consistently build and maintain proper customer relationships

•   Maintain constant communication with distributor and DIAGEO personnel on KPI’s, target account lists, activity, market objectives and expectations

•   Regularly survey the market to ensure that distribution, POS, programs and menus are executed to standard

•   Activation quality management – implement and oversee brand programs and events to engage consumers and trade

•   Establish and cultivate strong relationships with targeted gatekeepers and the United States Bartenders Guild (USBG)

•   Prepare weekly reports and tracking of target accounts, KPI’s, activity log, expenses, budgets and recap sheets

•   Manage and stay within all assigned budget allocations and track incurred expenses

•   Adhere to all federal liquor regulations and local state laws


Job Requirements

•   Minimum 3 years work experience in the on and off premise, distributor experience preferred

•   Bachelor's degree

•   Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

•   Must have strong PC skills (MS office, including PowerPoint and Excel)

•   Strong budget management skills

•   Excellent prioritization and multi-tasking abilities

•   Must live in the Boston area

posting.title: On Premise Diamond Account Specialist - Los Angeles
posting.description:
The On Premise Diamond Account Specialist is responsible for driving the growth and visibility of Proximo’s Core, Luxury brand portfolio within assigned key on-premise accounts. 

Operating as a 1099 contractor through IXM, this role focuses on executing sales strategies, building relationships, and implementing consumer engagement programs, all while managing a specific travel and entertainment budget and achieving established KPIs.

Key Responsibilities

·    Account Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key on-premise accounts to maximize brand presence and sales opportunities for Proximo’s core brands.

·    Sales & Brand Building: Execute selling strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets, ensuring optimal product placement and visibility within accounts.

·    Education & Training: Educate account staff on product knowledge, brand stories, and selling techniques to enhance advocacy and drive sales.

·    Consumer Engagement: Implement and oversee consumer pull-through programs and engagement activities that drive trial, awareness, and loyalty for core brands.

·    Resource Utilization: Leverage all available tools, marketing materials, and digital platforms to support account initiatives and program execution.

·    Compliance: Ensure all activities adhere strictly to state and federal alcohol laws and company policies.

·    Reporting & KPI Management: Track performance against defined KPIs and provide regular updates, insights, and recommendations for improvement.

·    Budget Management: Effectively manage an assigned travel and entertainment budget, ensuring efficient and compliant use of resources for maximum impact.

·    Social Media Influencer Engagement: Working with PR to drive Earned Media into accounts through Proximo Spirits Social Media partners.

·    Recap Activity: All activities will be managed and recapped through Pinata AI services. This will include all Sales / KPI / Finance management responsibilities.

Qualifications

·    Experience in on-premise beverage alcohol sales, preferably with premium or core spirits brands.

·    Mixology or Beverage Director background is required

·    Strong understanding of the beverage alcohol industry, distribution networks, and compliance landscape.

·    Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

·    Proven ability to manage budgets and work independently as a 1099 contractor.

·    Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales and engagement KPIs.

·    Familiarity with digital tools, CRM systems, and marketing resources.

·    Ability to travel within assigned territory as needed.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·    Sales growth and volume targets for core brands within assigned accounts

·    Number and quality of consumer engagement programs executed

·    Account activation and retention rates

·    Brand Distribution and Menu printing in accordance with Sub-Channel Prioritization

·    Compliance with travel and entertainment budget

·    Adherence to all legal and company policy requirements

Employment Details

·    Employment Status: 1099 independent contractor under IXM on 1yr contract

·    Compensation: Based on achievement of KPIs and program execution

o Base Salary Range $70,000 to $80,000

o Bonus potential >40% of base salary 

·    Reports to: IXM Sales Team with overview of responsibilities reporting to Sr. Regional Director.

This position offers a unique opportunity to represent leading core brands in the Proximo portfolio, working autonomously to deliver results in a dynamic and highly regulated industry.

posting.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Houston, TX
posting.description:
Overview

CAB Enterprises, Inc (“CAB Enterprises, or the “Company”) is the exclusive sales and customer service Company representing Electrolit in the United States. The primary objective of CAB Enterprises is to lead the growth of Electrolit sales in the United States.


Position Summary

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will strategically and proactively source both passive and active candidates to build and maintain a high-quality talent pipeline for the company's current and future staffing needs. This role includes proficiently managing the applicant tracking system, reviewing resumes, and contacting candidates to determine their fit and interest. Additionally, the Specialist will collaborate closely with third-party agencies, recruiters, hiring managers, and other HR team members to ensure a positive candidate experience and a smooth hiring process.


Region: Houston, TX – onsite (hybrid)


Principal Duties

  • Consult and coordinate with management on current and future hiring needs
  • Source applicants to match hiring requirements
  • Create job descriptions and interview questions that reflect the requirements for each position
  • Plan interview and selection procedures, including screening calls, assessments and in-person interviews
  • Build and maintain relationships with potential candidates, recruitment agencies and associations
  • Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews with Hiring Managers
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring a positive candidate experience and timely follow-up
  • Extends offers and negotiate compensation
  • Support the onboarding process for new hires, including coordinating new hire paperwork and communicating with hiring managers and other members of the HR team
  • Prepare job offer materials in accordance with the job specifications
  • Update candidate records and update job postings in Applicant Tracking System
  • Assess and manage agency relationships
  • Explore and utilize various sourcing channels such as direct sourcing, universities, employee referrals, and career and job fairs
  • Performs other related duties as assigned to support the Human Resources Department
  • Perform other duties as required


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for working closely with others across various departments
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and manage competing priorities
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, or related field. Relevant experience may substitute for the degree requirement
  • At least three (3) years of proven work experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist or similar role
  • Experience with full-cycle recruiting using various interview techniques and evaluation methods
  • Proficiency with online job boards to post open positions and source candidates
  • Experience in using LinkedIn Talent Solutions to proactively source candidates is a plus!
  • Proficiency in documenting processes and keeping up with industry trends
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Applicant Tracking Systems


Other Requirements

  • Able and willing to travel (Travel up to 10%)
  • Must be able to lift 25 pounds at times
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the USA


The above statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the principal functions of the occupation and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be inherited in the occupation.


Cab Enterprises Inc. is committed to maintaining a work environment that promotes diversity and is free of discrimination. Except where prohibited by state law, all offers of employment might be subject of passing a drug test.
